Bridges quinn and Firedancer QUIC, with optional PCAP logging and a test client connection.

# Purpose
This file defines a test helper that connects a Quinn QUIC client to a Firedancer QUIC server over a local UDP socket. The main entry point, `quinn_to_fdquic`, sets up Firedancer objects such as `fd_udpsock_t`, `fd_quic_t`, and an optional PCAPNG capture path. It can also write TLS key log data into the capture file when the `PCAP` environment variable is set. The code uses a custom `IgnoreServerCert` type that implements `rustls::client::danger::ServerCertVerifier` and accepts all server certificates and signatures, which lets the client complete a test connection without normal certificate checks.

The file also starts a background thread that services the Firedancer UDP socket and QUIC state machine until the test ends, then checks QUIC metrics such as packet counts, connection counts, and retry counts. In parallel, it builds a Tokio runtime, creates a Quinn client endpoint with a `rustls` configuration, sets the ALPN protocol to `solana-tpu`, and connects to the local Firedancer listener. After the connection succeeds, it shuts down the service thread and calls `fd_halt()`. This code acts as an integration bridge between Quinn and Firedancer and exposes no general public API beyond the test support function.
